title: Verify monetary representation in USD
gherkin:
Feature: Monetary representation consistency
  Scenario: Display monetary value in USD
    Given the monetary value is 100.00
    When the system displays the value
    Then the displayed value should be "$100.00"
rationale: To ensure that monetary values in USD are displayed correctly with the appropriate currency symbol and format.
generationSummary: This document outlines Gherkin test cases to ensure consistency in monetary representations across the system as specified in the requirement.
